apps.localizedDescription:
Status:

• The IPA is unsigned. Players sign and install it themselves with AltStore, SideStore, KSign or ESign. TestFlight and App Store distribution are not set up.

Features:

• Native Snakey Rain controller in Loadout: public or personal login, character and compatible skin/tag/accessory editors, 14 modes, live settings, and an arena panel dragged by its bottom handle and fitted to the screen. Character patterns keep palette, colour-wheel and Wyrm bead colours in every preview. Panel text/border and fill colours are adjustable. Settings are shared with Android; credentials and private bot tag codes remain in this phone's Keychain. Device bot spawn and full browser-extension parity remain unverified.
